name: RSSMonster
short_desc: Self-hosted RSS reader with smart folders and search
author: pietheinstrengholt
description:
RSSMonster is a modern, multi-user RSS reader with smart folders, full-text search, a three-pane reading layout and Fever / Google Reader API compatibility.

This definition uses the SQLite profile with a crawl worker, an AI worker and the inference service. Every AI capability (embeddings, summaries/tags, scoring, assistant) goes to one OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as a LiteLLM gateway: no model is downloaded or run locally.

form_fields.label: Fever credential secret
form_fields.hint: Also derives the key encrypting stored inference API keys. Changing it invalidates them.

form_fields.label: Allow registration
form_fields.hint: The first registered account becomes admin. Disable once your accounts exist, before exposing the instance.

form_fields.label: Enable AI
form_fields.hint: Summaries, tags, scores, semantic search and assistant through the endpoint below.

form_fields.label: Embedding model
form_fields.hint: Definitive for the database: vectors from different models cannot be mixed and are not migrated.

form_fields.label: Generation model
form_fields.hint: Summaries, tags, labels and article scoring.

form_fields.label: Summary language
form_fields.hint: Language of the AI bullet summaries, e.g. French. Empty keeps upstream behaviour (usually English). Existing summaries are not regenerated.
